name: Abyss / Pneumatic harpoon

request.text: One shot from a fictional pneumatic diver harpoon weapon. A forceful compressed air thump and crisp metal latch, followed by a short airy pressure hiss with a few tiny wet bubbles. Close mechanical sound, compact and tactile, distinct from a firearm. One immediate event only. Dry isolated game asset, no underwater ambience, no music, no speech, no repeated firing.
